title: ProductPrd:Ontology

_meta.purpose: Ontology + Knowledge Graph merged into one product PRD — machine-optimized. Ontology = typed entity/link/action schema layer. KG = runtime graph state (semantic+kinetic+dynamic 3-layer per $ref:specs/knowledge-graph-schema.json + $ref:registry/knowledge-graph-{semantic,kinetic,dynamic}.json).

north_star_ref: $ref:bominal/decisions/ADR-0106 (engine-enforced cryptographically-auditable typed-entity layer; Palantir-Foundry-style ontology pattern; platform value compounds when every surface speaks the same typed object)

target_users.interface_ref: $ref:specs/products/workflow.json (typed entity-refs in workflow steps; safe action invocation)

target_users.interface: per-vertical entity extensions overlaid on canonical types

acceptance_criteria.given: entity instance create with tier-classified properties
acceptance_criteria.then: per-property tier enforced; data_class recorded; entity_created audit row emitted
cardinality enforced (1:1/1:N/M:N); cross-tenant link refused unless explicit policy permits
executes only if policy permits; action_invoked row with provenance (caller, tier, refs)
type checked at workflow-deploy time, NOT runtime; deploy fails on unknown type

acceptance_criteria.given: query for entities matching graph traversal (semantic+kinetic+dynamic)
acceptance_criteria.then: returns within latency budget; cross-tier joins enforce tier ceiling
Cedar autonomy_tier ceiling enforced; LLM input as data; audit row emitted
overlay fields available; base fields unchanged elsewhere
returns within freshness budget (<2s lag); never silent stale
audit topic emitted; idempotency_key honored; lock pattern engaged

stable: LLM tool-call binding via Foundry registry
GA: cross-cell federation via Ontology adapter (not direct DB)

out_of_scope.why: use a NoSQL DB; this is typed-only

out_of_scope.item: cross-tenant entity sharing without explicit Cedar policy

out_of_scope.why: Cedar is sole gate per AC-04

out_of_scope.item: eventual-consistency dynamic reads without freshness budget

data_model.entities_ref: $ref:crates/oya-ontology-kernel/src/lib.rs (current: data-classed ObjectEntity/ObjectProperty kernel with PropertyTier classification; planned: EntityType with PropertyDescriptor[Tier classification per $ref:bominal/decisions/ADR-0133], EntityInstance, ActionInvocation with autonomy_tier)

optimization_practices.practice: per-tenant cell pinning + per-jurisdiction overlay at edge
type descriptors at CDN edge; instance reads in-memory + Redis
Foundry ontology-optimizer capability tunes per-type cache TTL

external_rejected.why: build atop postgres RLS; per-tenant isolation easier; per-tier classification not native in graph DBs

metrics.name: action_audit_chain_completeness_pct
metrics.verification_ref: jq cross-check audit-chain vs invocation count

risks.mitigation: schema_version field + per-type evolution policy (analogous to $ref:bominal/decisions/ADR-0149) + back-compat lane

risks.risk: LLM tool-call escalates autonomy beyond tier

risks.mitigation: AC-09 freshness budget enforced; never silent stale

measurable_patches: each action emits action_id, object_ids, link_ids, rule_id, idempotency_key, actor_principal, permission_decision_ref, audit_chain_ref
schema distinguishes tenant_private, org_shared, public_projection spaces
Cedar policy coverage proves ontology_resource and object_link_data tiers before action execution
competitive.measurable: source-backed patch backlog must pass before GA; no unsourced single-tenant or latency claims

where_oyatie_lacks_or_is_underspecified: vector retrieval boundary away from policy truth
measurable_patches: traversal tests cover label, typed-edge, property-filter, shortest-path, explain-plan receipt
every queryable property/link has explicit index/constraint status or no_index_reason
competitive.measurable: Neo4j informs projections only; external graph DB remains forbidden as authority

measurable_patches: roundtrip fixtures preserve entity_id, edge_type, data_class, tenant_id, audit provenance
algorithm result has source_snapshot_digest, algorithm_id, params, generated_at and cannot mutate canonical graph
mutation gate rejects vector-only evidence without canonical row/action receipt
competitive.measurable: Neptune is interop/analytics inspiration only; no AWS-only runtime authority

observed_strengths: SPARQL rewriting to native source syntax
where_oyatie_lacks_or_is_underspecified: reasoning layer separated from canonical writes
measurable_patches: mapping receipt includes source_kind, schema_digest, mapping_digest, owner, credential_mode, data_class, freshness_budget, materialize_or_virtualize decision
inferred edges carry inference_rule_id + source_snapshot_digest and cannot satisfy mutation/audit obligations alone
adapter registration fails without credential_mode and named_scope_policy
competitive.measurable: Stardog informs adapter/reasoning patterns only; no external graph DB dependency

best_practices.rule: default-deny cross-tenant links; Cedar required to permit
type checking at workflow-deploy time, not runtime
cryptographically signed audit chain per action (post-$ref:docs/decisions/ADR-0083 cryptographic chain)
Cedar autonomy_tier ceiling on LLM tool-calls
per-tenant Postgres RLS at DB layer
best_practices.rationale: physically impossible cross-tenant query without policy escalation

best_practices.rule: competitive claims require official-source evidence_refs plus concrete patch/verification; unsourced benchmark deltas are forbidden
every ontology action mutation emits transaction receipt + audit_chain_ref before canonical state changes
graph query/vector/reasoning outputs are retrieval or derived evidence only; policy and mutation truth require canonical entity/action receipts
virtual/external source adapters require mapping receipt, credential_mode, data_class, named_scope_policy, and freshness_budget

patterns.when: workflow needs entity in another cell
every write goes through kinetic layer
derived graph analytics output informs investigation
external enterprise source is mapped into ontology

anti_patterns.name: direct_cross_cell_db_access
anti_patterns.detection: code review + cargo-deny on DB-driver crate visibility

anti_patterns.name: external_graph_db_dep
anti_patterns.why_forbidden: cross-tenant isolation harder; we have Postgres RLS

anti_patterns.name: unsourced_ontology_competitor_benchmark_claim
anti_patterns.why_forbidden: competitive deltas must cite official source evidence and distinguish internal targets from measured external facts

anti_patterns.name: external_graph_engine_as_canonical_authority
anti_patterns.why_forbidden: Neo4j/Neptune/Stardog may inform adapters, but Oyatie ontology kernel remains canonical
anti_patterns.detection_lane: cargo-deny denylist + ontology adapter boundary validator

anti_patterns.name: vector_or_reasoning_output_as_policy_truth
anti_patterns.why_forbidden: approximate retrieval and inferred projections cannot authorize or mutate canonical state
anti_patterns.detection_lane: policy/action gate requires canonical entity_id + permission proof + action receipt

anti_patterns.name: virtual_graph_without_pass_through_or_named_scope_security
anti_patterns.why_forbidden: external-source reads must preserve user/source permissions and data-class scope

anti_patterns.name: action_without_transaction_receipt
anti_patterns.why_forbidden: object/link mutations need deterministic provenance before state change

scalability.target: 10K tenants per cluster + 1B entities per region + 100M actions per day per region

security.target: per-tenant Postgres RLS + Cedar at every action + tier classification on every property + cryptographically-signed audit chain (post-ADR-0083)

performance.target: type-lookup p99 <5ms + entity-read p99 <20ms + action p99 <50ms + 3-layer KG join p99 <200ms

efficiency.target: <$0.001 per entity-read + <$0.01 per action + per-tenant overhead <$10/month

reliability.target: type registry SLO 99.95% + instance store SLO 99.95% + MTTR <60s auto-rollback canary

user_experience.accessibility_coverage: WCAG 2.2 AA minimum for graph explorer, schema admin, SDK docs, action preview, and audit evidence surfaces; graph always has table/tree mirror
user_experience.internationalization_scope: locale-aware-dynamic for schema labels, policy/action copy, and SDK docs; ko-KR and en-US launch gates

journey_critical_paths.time_to_success_target: < 10 minutes from type draft to review-ready schema
< 3 minutes from error code to fix path

error_state_coverage.tier_violation: inline field redaction plus policy preview and remediation
error_state_coverage.cross_tenant_link_denied: blocking policy explanation with source/target tenant redacted as required
error_state_coverage.stale_dynamic_state: freshness badge and disabled action until telemetry meets budget
error_state_coverage.schema_evolution_break: semantic diff viewer identifies breaking callers and compatibility lane

user_experience.offline_behavior: schema docs and read-only cached graph slices may be viewed offline; mutations/actions require online Cedar and freshness checks
user_experience.loading_state_coverage: paginated graph skeletons, progressive table/tree render, determinate export progress; no spinner-only graph state

decision_log.decision: Ontology and Knowledge Graph are ONE product per user pick (typed schema + 3-layer KG runtime)
ADR-0122 ontology kernel naming ratified for the same PR sequence
F-CRATE-RENAME-ONTOLOGY-SWEEP resolved: oya-ontology-kernel is a workspace crate and registry/catalog/oya-ontology-kernel.yaml is the current catalog ref
